sanskrit: skandanandigaṇākīrṇaṃ viśveśvarasamanvitammahodarasamāyuktamapsarobhiḥ samāvṛtamgandharvādi gaṇopetaṃ siddhasaṅghaiśca saṃyutamnārada pramukhaiścaiva gītanṛttaviśāradaiḥsarvānugrahakartāraṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanamtatrasthaṃ devadeveśamumayāsahitaṃ śivamsaṃśayā viṣṭacittastu candro vedavidāṃpatiḥrodamāno bravīdvākyamucchasaṃśca punaḥ punaḥ ||mohitaṃ māyayā sarvaṃ brahāṇḍaṃ sa carācaramsarveṣāṃ niścitā buddhiḥ praṇaṣṭā iti me matiḥtvayoktasyaiva candrasya buddhi rūpasya nityaśaḥsvayamevamasaunaṣṭaścintayāyaḥ prakalpitaḥprayuktā ca yathā vīṇā tantrīsvara samanvitātathā mantrā tadākārā vidyāścaiva sahasraśaḥkṛtake naiva santuṣṭā bhrāmitā māyayā punaḥuccāryamāṇā ye mantrā na te samyak tvayoditāḥp. 56b) māyāsvapnopamāḥ sarve mudrādhyanādi dhāraṇāḥdevyā vināyakasyaiva ṣaṇmukhasya trilocanamvāsukirgāruḍaścaiva brahmaṇo viṣṇurudrayoḥdurvāsapramukhādīnāṃ munīnāṃ yastu saṃhitaḥsaṃprāptāvividhākārā vidyāścāpi sahasraśaḥtatsantuṣṭa mahādeva śirassthena mayā śrutamna jñātaṃ kasyacijjñānaṃ śārīraṃ gūḍhagocaramkṛtakaṃ naiva santuṣṭāḥ svacittamuṣitāḥ sthitāḥsambhāvaṃ kasyacennoktaṃ mohitāḥ paramārthikāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00263 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dīyate kasya vā piṇḍaṃ vāyurvāyau pralīyateākāśe tu tathākāśaṃ manobuddhirahaṃ tathāko yaṃ māṃsa mayo deho dagdho vā prāṇibhakṣitaḥna rūpaṃ tasya no varṇo na sthānaṃ na ca dhāraṇānarakāśśāsanāścaiva pretapuṇyaṃ vasetakaḥnīyante bahubhiḥkālaireko vā kiṃ bahūnnayetlakṣasaṅkhyāśca vahavastatra kālaḥkimāgataḥnīyante bahubhiḥ kiṃ vā etatsarvaṃ vadasva meyanna kasya cidākhyātaṃ nissaṃśaya karaṃparamtāneśa parameśāna mohanyuktā tu mātṛkāsaṃbhavanti yathovarṇāḥ svaravyañjanasaṃjñakāḥtasyādhikāraṇaṃ yat tad vāgbhirvaktuṃ na śakyatetajjñātvā bījarājaṃ tu varuṇānalamadhyagamparivārāṅga vistāraṃ nāmajāti vivarjitamśabdāvasthaṃ parityajya bodharūpeṇasaṃsthitamasvaraṃ paramaṃ mantraṃ yogināṃ mokṣadaṃ dhruvamśaśadhavaravidyāṃ ca muhūrtadinarātribhiḥkīlanāddvijarājaivamevaṃ kālobhidhīyatenīyate dehasaṃsthena karmaṇākālarūpiṇāsukhaduḥkha phalaṃ bhuṅkte jīvaḥ svasyaivakarmaṇaḥāyuḥ kṣīṇāśca ye bhūtāstiryañcomānuṣāḥ surāḥna dveṣānna ca vairāgyāṅkālaḥ karmedamucyatekiṃ vidhau devadeveśa jīvonāmamaheśvarakathaṃ kālaḥ praśamati jīva sthāne trilocanaśṛṇu tāvat pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ bhuvi durlabham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00263 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śaktigarbha sthito nityaṃ rūpaṃ dhyānavivarjitamp. 59b) upamānavaśaścandra śṛṇu pātrastu kalpitaḥtrividhaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ śāktogrā kārakaḥ smṛtaḥsarvopamānarahitaḥ kalpanā kālavarjitaḥguṇātmikā tu vijñeyā prakṛtistattva rūpiṇīeṣā prakṛtirutpanā saṃsthitā sarva dehiṣuetacchrutvā dhva?hāsena candro vedavidāṃbaraḥp. 60a) pañcabhūtātmakaṃ piṇḍaṃ pañcasthāna gataṃ prabhoye ye bhāvā yathā yātāstathā tatra layaṃ gatāḥsarvajñasaṃśayasyāsya kiṃ bravihi vinirṇayammūrtairbrahmādibhiścaiva vedarājayamena caātmārthaṃ racitaṃ śāstraṃ kriyākāṇḍamanuttamamprajārthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ jīvanopāya hetukamp. 60b) annena jīvalokoyaṃ vartate sarvasambhavaḥśrāddhadānādikaṃ karma na ca piṇḍodaka kriyākutaḥ piṇḍaṃ kutaḥ śrāddhaṃ kutodāhādi lakṣaṇamsthiti kāraṇahetuṃ tvādbhūtā * * *? ta saṃskṛtamsvakarmaṇā sukhaṃ bhuṅkte duḥkhaṃ bhuṅkte svakarmaṇāyena yena svabhāvena prakṛtisthāṃ tyajet tanump. 61a) jīvaḥ saṃsarate dehānna cāsau mriyate punaḥna naṣṭaścaiva notpanno baddho mukto na cāpyasauna kṛtirguṇapāśaistu veṣṭitāssarvadehināmyena bhāvena yo tyantaḥ prakṛtergacchate punaḥjīvo dvandva vinirmuktaḥ sarvakarmasusaṃsthitaḥyathā vṛtau gatau vāyuḥ saṃsthitasya dvijeśvara
source_edition: Muktabodha M00263 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: p. 61b) tatrasthaṃ yatparaṃ śūnyaṃ candrajīvaṃ tu taṃ viduḥyat tat tattvadharaṃ śūnyaṃ sa kathaṃ caiva naśyatisahasā ca ghaṭe bhinne na vāyurvidyate kvacitdarpaṇānanasaṃyoga jalārka pratibimbitejalakṣayādyathā cārko naiva naśyati vai kvacitsarvagaḥ sarvakartā ca sarvadvandva bahiṣkṛtaḥpuṣpairgandhai tilaistailaṃ kṣīre sarpistato nalaḥśakterabhyantare jīvaḥ saṃsthito naiva lipyatecatuṣkena pranaṣṭe tu tannabho naiva naśyatina tasya kālo mṛtyurvā na piṇḍaḥ śrāddhalakṣaṇametacchrutvādyavai candraḥ praphultakamalekṣaṇaḥmānaṃ tu karaṇaṃ tasya pramāṇaṃ vada bhairavaprāṇāpānapravāhena gacchate viśate punaḥguṇāḥ sarve sthitāstasyā uparāgāmaṇerivatena tena svabhāvena tatra tatrāvatiṣṭhatedarpaṇe ca yathā cchāyā jalamadhye tu tārakāḥkarmaṇā svena bhāvena taṃ tu bhuñjanti dehinaḥevaṃ śaktikanirjīvaḥ sukhadohlādakaḥ smṛtaḥkālāgnyādi śivāntaṃ ca yadrūpaṃ kiñcid dṛśyateaśmāntaragataścaiva asthirandhraśca saṃsthitaḥrahasyaṃ tedya vakṣyāmi ekāgraḥ śṛṇu tatparaḥvāyuścakhaṃmanobuddhirahaṅkāraśca ye guṇāḥyat kiñcit sakalaṃ bhāvaṃ rūpataḥ keṣusaṃsthitambhrāntiṃ tyaja sa vai putra sarvaṃ śūnye pratiṣṭhitamvarṇebhyaśca tathā mantrā mantrebhyaḥ sṛṣṭiravyayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00263 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yugādinā tato adya nityaṃ sada sataḥ paramnāyaṃ piṇḍesti na śrāddhaṃ na kālakalanā tathābhūtagrāmeṣu sarveṣu śaktyantarvasate prabhuḥsthitaṃ tadeva bhāṇḍāsthaṃ sarvasya varavarṇakamjñānabhedo na vidyeta teṣāṃ śāstrāgameṣu caprakṛtirnāmadeveśa ādhāradharaṇī yathāna naṣṭā na ca saṃbhrāntiradyāpi parameśvarasaro madhye ca patitā galitā ekatāṃ gatāḥnirguṇatvaṃ guṇaṃ yasya arūpaṃ caiva rūpakamtena sarvamidaṃ vyāptamābrahmabhuvanāntikamāṇavaṃ ca tathā śāktaṃ bindunādātmakaṃ ca yatsarvaśivamayaṃ candra śivo jīvaḥ prakīrtitaḥadhyātmajñānasambodhaṃ śaktigarbhaṃ tu yo bhyasetajarāmarabhūto vai bhavate nātrasaṃśayaḥkarmaṇāṃ caiva mahato guṇānāṃ bhūtajastathāidaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ kathayāmi tavākhilamp. 65a) paśutvaṃ ca patitvaṃ ca dvau bhedau ca śarīriṇāmyathābhrairarkaraśmibhyo darpaṇaṃ ca malena caajñānāddṛśyate janturguṇapāśaistu yantritaḥna deho mriyate bhuṅkte karmabhogeti tasya vaiprāpnoti jñānamabhyāsājjñānānmuktastu mocakaḥsarvagaṃ paramaṃ devaṃ hetūpādhivivarjitamp. 65b) vipro vā mūḍhabuddhiśca ajñāna spṛśya eva saḥtasya hastā tu vai grāhya sa ca pūjyo yathā hyahamajñānācca kriyākāṇḍaṃ jñānāt karmakṣayo bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00263 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ajñānāt karmapāśaistu prakṛtairbadhyate punaḥsarvaṃ jagat svadehaṃ vā parānandena pūritamna kālo na yamaḥ kaścidetā bāla vibhīṣakāḥp. 66a) kutaḥ kālaḥ kuto mṛtyurnarake śāsanāḥ kathamkāyaṃ śūnyamayaṃ kṛtvā na kiñcidapi carcayetguṇapāśairnibadhyante mūḍhāḥ pāparatāḥ punaḥtatra tatrājñā bhāvatvaṃ paśūnāṃ syāt sadodūpayadi jīvo hi muktaśca nīrūpaḥ khasvarūpakaḥetadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ tvat pramādāt kapāla bhṛtprakṛtirguṇasaṃpūrṇā mriyate jāyate tathāna jīvo bhuñjate karma na cāsau prakṛtirguṇaiḥsarvajñaḥ sarvagodhyakṣaḥ kharūpī khamanaḥ khagaḥte pi pra?mohamāpannā jīvaṃ jñānavidhau sadāpravṛtyarthaṃ tu bhūtānāṃ prakṛtārthamasaṃsthitaḥp. 67a) ādhāradharaṇī śaktiraśirāhaṃ sa rūpiṇīyathā veśmāntara gataṃ nabhaḥ sarvagataṃ sthitamtad vat sarvagataṃ brahma sarvatraiva susaṃsthitamtārakendra tyajabhrāntiṃ kimanyat kathayāmitetvat prasādānmayājñātaṃ jīvalakṣaṇamuttamamadya jātosmyahaṃ deva jñānenānena bhairavatoṣito vai mahādevaścandreṇa ca yathā kṛtaḥjñānabhogī ca madvākyāt pūrvoktamyā mṛtodbhavaevamuktvā yadā devo virarāma maheśvaraḥbhaktāyedaṃ pradātavyaṃ śraddhādānāya dhīmatesa mūḍhaḥ sarvadā tiṣṭedātmajñānenasaṃyutaḥ
